name: Garnier Light Complete VITAMIN C Face Serum 15ml | India
description:
Garnier Bright complete Vitamin C Booster Serum 15ml 

cleanse your face with a mild garnier light complete facewash and pat dry. take a pea sized amount of the vitamin c booster serum in your palms. spread it between your palms without rubbing too much. dab the serum all over your face and neck using small and gentle tapping motions. follow with the garnier light complete serum cream with spf 40 in the morning and garnier light complete night cream at night. for best results, use daily. 

What It Is 

Garnier Light Vitmamin C Booster Serum is a brightening and spot reduction formula in a face serum.What It Does 

Enriched with the power of 30X VITAMIN C and Lemons, the lightweight and non-oily formula instantly penetrates into the skin. It give you an instant glow and reduce spots in 3 DAYS. Dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types. 

Buy Garnier Light Vitmamin C Booster Serum Online 

Cleanse your face with a mild Garnier Light Complete facewash and pat dry.
